# Collaboration Files

This directory contains the issue and pull-request templates used to track role-scoped tasks and handoffs across the project:

- **Task template:** [ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.md](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/task.md)
- **Pull-request template:** [PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

Task ownership, execution order, and release gates are defined in [docs/workflow/README.md](../docs/workflow/README.md) and [docs/workflow/tasks.json](../docs/workflow/tasks.json). Credential-requiring Git operations remain with the repository owner.
